# BreathiZen (breathizen-us.onrender.com)

> breathizen-us.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about BreathiZen, a once-daily oral spray dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page, its Supplement Facts panel and supplied photos)
- Format: oral spray, 60 mL (2 oz); serving 4 sprays (0.60 mL) once daily; 100 servings per container
- Proprietary blend, 154 mg per serving: mullein (Verbascum thapsus) leaf extract 10:1, ginger (Zingiber officinale) root extract, organic lemon extract
- Other ingredients: purified water, glycerin, natural flavors, citric acid, potassium sorbate, sodium benzoate
- Packs: 1 bottle $69; 3 bottles $59 each ($177, free shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping); single payment, no auto-billing
- 60-day money-back guarantee; contact customer care before day 60
- Not a treatment for asthma, COPD or any breathing condition; ginger can add to blood thinners; citric acid can affect tooth enamel
